correctness.rationale: The full 27-coefficient triquadratic system is 1-jet-spanned; its single-mark incidence is an irreducible P23-bundle over the threefold and its two-mark incidence over distinct base coordinates an irreducible P20-bundle, yielding two-transitivity of each root cover. Independent vertical Hessian coefficients make the rank-one A2 incidence irreducible of codimension one; a local y^3+s y deformation gives one transposition. The supplied exact mod-101 discriminant checker confirms a general coefficient witness with three degree-24 squarefree polynomials, and a cusp witness with derivative gcd degrees (1,0,0), hence one cusp boundary where both other factors are etale. All three pure transpositions and 2-transitivity generate the full product \(S_{24}^3\). Limits: the computation certifies existence, the incidence and deformation arguments prove the group. The witnesses were executed from the new package path.

originality.rationale: The claim is simultaneous geometric Galois monodromy \(S_{24}^3\) for the three correlated coordinate pencils of a triquadratic K3. The initiating Fano-double-cover paper establishes three fibrations, not their common splitting field. Dao states 24 nodal fibers individually. Zhan proves \(S_{24}\) for the universal elliptic K3 family with section, which does not determine the joint group for this special three-pencil locus. A previous calculation of the same Fano branch family describes individual line-scheme covers and nodal values, not inter-pencil splitting-field linear disjointness. A decisive new feature is a cusp loop acting by a transposition in exactly one of three factors. No full prior covering theorem was found; unindexed equivalent results remain possible.

value.rationale: This is a structural three-way independence theorem for natural related discriminant covers of a Fano threefold, a stronger result than 24 nodal fibers or three marginal symmetric groups. Pure transpositions rule out shared sign fields and any proper subdirect product. It supplies the maximal generic field compositum and enables Hilbert-irreducible dense arithmetic realizations. It addresses a naturally attached full arithmetic invariant and is not a trivial normalization or arbitrary finite slice.
